steps.name: Run sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y poppler-utils
Install browser for public issuer API fallback
Validate public holdings API identities and complete weights
Discover complete issuer portfolios without replacing qualified values on failure

Run python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_dws_liquidity_funds.py' && python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_hsbc_jpm_holdings.py' && python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_pending_sources.py'
Check access to remaining unqualified sources
Verify complete portfolios in the browser
Run echo 'Collecte partielle : dernières valeurs fiables conservées ; données validées publiées si les contrôles réussissent.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
